shortThesis: CivicState is a draft civic-letter workflow; prove paid demand and deliverability before pitching it.

authority.adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

inputs.registryNotes: Watchlist; personal/research asset; not near-term investible BOS unless operator confirms business pitch

methods: Workspace-only file review; no network research used.
Compared planning documents against current application code.
Tagged external or market claims as assumptions and repo/code facts as evidence.

sources.use: original thesis, demand hypothesis, distribution hypothesis

thesis.current: A resident-facing civic workflow can convert concrete civic frustration into paid, researched, citation-backed constituent letters.

customer.primary: US resident with a concrete civic concern and low confidence in jurisdiction research, formal drafting, or official targeting.
excluded: Legal claimants seeking filings or demand letters

revenueModel.future: Human review, delivery add-ons, and organization API remain deferred assumptions.

marketSizing.method: Bottoms-up scenario model because workspace-only mode prevents external market research.
marketSizing.beachhead: $135,000 annual gross revenue [assumption: 10,000 annual packages x $13.50]
marketSizing.narrowServiceable: $1,350,000 annual gross revenue [assumption: 100,000 annual packages x $13.50]
marketSizing.wideServiceable: $13,500,000 annual gross revenue [assumption: 1,000,000 annual packages x $13.50]

competition: Resistbot [assumption: general market knowledge, unverified workspace-only]
Change.org [assumption: general market knowledge, unverified workspace-only]
Quorum/FiscalNote/VoterVoice-style advocacy platforms [assumption: general market knowledge, unverified workspace-only]
Manual email plus free generative AI [assumption: behavioral substitute]

validationGates.evidenceNeeded: Stripe checkout export and funnel count

validationGates.target: 85% delivered status on government domains [assumption: EIR threshold]
95% verified-citation retention on seeded tests [assumption: EIR threshold]
validationGates.evidenceNeeded: Seeded issue test results and verifier logs

holes: No workspace evidence of live paid customers.
No workspace evidence of production deliverability to government officials.
No workspace evidence that local-official provider coverage is sufficient.
Registry warns the asset may be personal/research rather than near-term investible.
mitigations: Run paid beta before public acquisition.
Test deliverability before sending real user mail.
Evaluate officials providers across representative ZIP codes.
Require operator ruling before changing draft authority.
residualRisks: Low-ticket civic demand may not cover support burden.
AI-assisted official mail may be filtered or ignored.
Citation mistakes could create reputational or legal-adjacent exposure.

goToMarket.motion: Manual beta recruitment, then SEO/public campaign pages only after paid delivery works.

roadmap.shape: single-worker-sized validation tasks mapped to BUSINESS.md headings

sensitivity.note: Treat as personal/research asset until operator confirms business pitch.
